label: 4. I don't mean to bother you,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I don't mean to bother you,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: but was I all right yesterday?
Yes, you spoke very clearly during your speech.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Oh, sorry.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I suppose I should explain.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: No, not that.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'm talking about my swimsuit.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I was wondering how I looked in it.
In that case, you were absolutely sublime.
I was tempted to splash you with water.
There's no response from Helm for a while.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'm glad to hear that.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I think that was the only issue I had at the moment.
Were there other issues before?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: the string was a bit too thin,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: and the swimsuit itself was rather revealing,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: so I was concerned that I'd have a wardrobe malfunction

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: and end up revealing more than I intended

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: if the string came loose.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I was constantly checking myself in the mirror

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: and using my phone

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: to make sure nothing was out of place.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Hmmm

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Now that I think about it,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I really shouldn't be speaking about such things to a male like you.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Forget everything I just said.
Sorry, but it's all stuck in my head now.
Sure thing, hehe.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'm begging you, just act as if this conversation never happened.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: This is no laughing matter.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Please.
All right, since you said please.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I know it may have seemed like I was fishing for a compliment,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: but I wasn't.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: And perhaps...

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I mean...

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: If you end up discovering that anything

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: about my swimsuit is out of place,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'd rather you not pretend as if you didn't see it.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Instead, could you inform me surreptitiously?
No problem.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I trust you.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: If there are any other issues in the future, I'll come to you.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: In the meantime, please keep your attention on my swimsuit.
Oh believe me, I will.
It appears I've been assigned the enviable task of keeping a close eye on Helm's alluring swimsuit.
